title: Bug Hunt guard order
objective: Guards run before pipes, making authorization an independent boundary for protected requests.
misconception: The guard authorizes everyone and the team mistakenly relies on validation to protect private records.
acceptance: Unauthenticated requests are denied before a handler executes; authorized invalid bodies still return 400.
securityBoundary: Authorization must not depend on client-side form validation, a permissive guard, or a role string in JSON.
